units.source_text: 我找了个水边的岩石休息，准备吃饭。

en.t: I found a rock by the water to rest on and got ready to eat.

units.source_text: 光是诸如打开牛肉罐头啦，寻找枯枝生成篝火啦等等，就花费了十几分钟。

en.t: Just opening a can of beef, looking for dry branches to make a campfire, and things like that took more than ten minutes.

units.source_text: 不知何时一直跟我作对的浓雾消散了。

en.t: Before I knew it, the thick fog that had been working against me had cleared away.

units.source_text: 我啃着面包，看了一眼手表，上面显示已经一点二十分了。

en.t: As I gnawed at my bread, I glanced at my watch, which showed that it was already one twenty.

units.source_text: 令我更加诧异的是，手表的圆玻璃盘上出现了一张可怕的脸。

en.t: What startled me even more was that a terrifying face had appeared on the round glass face of my watch.

units.source_text: 我受惊过度，回头一看，就这样，我这辈子第一次看见了河童。

en.t: Badly frightened, I turned to look back, and that was how I saw a kappa for the first time in my life.

units.source_text: 我身后的岩石上出现了一只河童，一只和画上一摸一样的河童。

en.t: On the rock behind me, a kappa had appeared, a kappa exactly like the ones in pictures.

units.source_text: 它抱着白桦树枝，一只手平支在前额上遮阳光，满眼好奇的俯视着我。

en.t: It was holding birch branches, shading its forehead from the sun with one outstretched hand, and looking down at me with eyes full of curiosity.
